title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Shocked you didn’t ask me for any info. I would have given you everything hours ago. Too bad
You guys are all sitting around playing patty cake with each other, I see
If that’s what you call it
I do have to pick your brain about something non-arbitration related, though
Also, how much did Nick sign for
I haven’t really paid attention so hopefully less than $20M
There’s the Sam I know and love
Hey I hear Nick got done!

Basically, I’m looking for a brief rundown on luxury tax. More specifically, involving Nats if, say, they sign Harper. Because it would seem to me that if they did that, wouldn’t they eventually be facing all those sanctions —taxes, lost draft picks — that you guys almost were?
I’m looking for info on the serious luxury tax offenders
Ok I’m out drinking right now. Let’s talk tomorrow
